_comment: Fictional example values for Guangzhou BrightTable Ceramics (fictional example). Copy this file to config.json and replace every value with your own. Never commit config.json. API keys never go in this file; they live in environment variables only.

excluded_markets.reason: Fictional placeholder: replace with markets you choose not to serve and your own reason for each

exclusion_rules: Suspected competitors: companies that manufacture or own a brand in our core category go to the intelligence pool, never the outreach pool
Existing customers and companies already in a commercial relationship are never cold-contacted
Replace these examples with your own exclusion rules
fit_signals: import record under our HS codes
value_points: Chip-resistant stoneware keeps breakage in freight and storage low.
One set design sells across everyday dining, gifting, and hospitality restocking.
Stable year-round demand instead of a single season.
_search_note: Search layer scripts/web_search.py reads its key from environment variables only: SERPER_API_KEY / TAVILY_API_KEY / BRAVE_API_KEY (any one; Serper preferred). With none set, the script falls back per AGENTS.md.
_sender_note: scripts/send_mail.py resolves the From address in this order: the SMTP_FROM environment variable first, then sender_email in this config, then SMTP_USER. If SMTP_FROM and sender_email are both set and differ, SMTP_FROM wins; scripts/doctor.py warns about that case.
